# DebugInput

> DebugInput is a Kotlin compiler and Gradle plugin that turns annotated Kotlin values and enum-class constructor vals into persistent, type-safe controls in Android and iOS debug builds.

Canonical documentation: https://rohittp.com/DebugInput/
Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/DebugInput
Public Maven repository: https://maven.rohittp.com
Plugin id: com.rohittp.debug-input
Compose coordinate: com.rohittp:debug-input-compose
Required Kotlin version: 2.3.21

## Installation

Add https://maven.rohittp.com to both pluginManagement.repositories and dependencyResolutionManagement.repositories. Apply com.rohittp.debug-input to modules declaring inputs and to the module that hosts DebugInputsPage(). Add com.rohittp:debug-input-compose:<version> to that page-hosting module.

## Core API

- @DebugInput(docs = "", section = "") annotates a property or enum class.
- DebugInputsPage() renders generated sections, editors, reset actions, KDoc, and Copy JSON.
- Explicit docs wins over declaration KDoc. The default section is the file, class, object, or enum name.
- An annotated enum class creates one input for every supported constructor val on every constant.

## Supported types

Byte, Short, Int, Long, Float, Double, Boolean, Char, String, enums, List, Set, Array, all eight primitive arrays, Pair, and Triple. Maps, nested containers, and enums inside containers are unsupported.

## Production behavior

Overrides are active only in debug builds. Production reads return source defaults. Tester JSON is a handoff for developers to review and apply to Kotlin declarations; it is not production runtime configuration.
